title: 🇮🇱 Urgent Requirement for Israel – Tunnel Project
content:
Daily Job Alert Join the Whatsapp Channel Join Now

🏢 Company Name: Flytap Services Pvt. Ltd.
📌 Job Role:

👷 1. Field Manager

  • Supervise and coordinate workforce on project sites.
  • Manage daily site operations and logistics.
  • Communicate between management and workers.
  • Ensure safety, productivity, and work quality.
  • Prepare daily progress reports.
  • Coordinate transportation and manpower deployment.

👷 2. South Indian Civil Engineer (Tamil)

  • Supervise tunnel and infrastructure construction activities.
  • Execute project work according to approved drawings.
  • Coordinate with site teams and subcontractors.
  • Ensure quality control and safety compliance.
  • Prepare daily progress reports and documentation.
  • Use AutoCAD and MS Office for project management.

👷 3. South Indian Civil Foreman (Tamil)

  • Lead civil construction teams on site.
  • Supervise road, pipeline, and infrastructure works.
  • Read and implement engineering drawings.
  • Allocate daily work to labor teams.
  • Monitor work quality and safety standards.
  • Report project progress to engineers.

🛠 4. Residential MTC & Handyman Specialist

  • Perform plumbing, electrical, carpentry, and maintenance work.
  • Repair residential apartments and facilities.
  • Troubleshoot maintenance issues.
  • Carry out preventive maintenance.
  • Assist with worker transportation when required.
  • Maintain tools and equipment properly.

🚛 5. Commercial Driver & Logistics Operator

  • Operate trucks, dumpers, pickups, trailers, or cranes safely.
  • Transport workers, equipment, and construction materials.
  • Handle loading and unloading operations.
  • Perform vehicle inspection before and after duty.
  • Maintain trip records and delivery reports.
  • Follow GPS routes and company safety policies.

🧱 6. All Rounder Mason

  • Perform brickwork, blockwork, plastering, and concrete finishing.
  • Construct walls, foundations, and structural elements.
  • Read basic construction drawings.
  • Repair damaged concrete structures.
  • Ensure quality workmanship and site safety.

🪚 7. Shuttering Carpenter

  • Install and dismantle formwork and shuttering.
  • Prepare molds for concrete structures.
  • Read construction drawings accurately.
  • Measure, cut, and assemble shuttering materials.
  • Ensure proper alignment before concrete pouring.

🏗 8. Carpenter Foreman

  • Supervise carpentry teams on construction sites.
  • Read and interpret technical drawings.
  • Allocate work and monitor productivity.
  • Ensure proper installation of wooden structures and formwork.
  • Maintain safety and quality standards.
  • Coordinate with engineers and project managers.

🚜 9. Telehandler Operator

  • Operate telehandler safely on construction sites.
  • Lift and transport heavy construction materials.
  • Perform daily equipment inspections.
  • Carry out basic machine maintenance.
  • Follow lifting plans and site safety regulations.
  • Support material handling during tunnel construction.

💰 Salary: 6500 – 9000 ILS
📍 Location: ISRAEL
📅 Interview Date: CV or Working Video along with the Introduction Video Selection.
📞 Contact Number: +91 9868226655, +91 9211220653, +91 9211220654

📄 Job Description:

FTS Flytap Services Pvt. Ltd. is hiring experienced professionals for a reputed Israel Tunnel Project. Vacancies include Field Manager, South Indian Civil Engineer (Tamil), South Indian Civil Foreman (Tamil), Residential MTC & Handyman Specialist, Commercial Driver & Logistics Operator, All Rounder Mason, Shuttering Carpenter, Carpenter Foreman, and Telehandler Operator. Salaries range from 6,500 ILS to 9,000 ILS depending on the position and experience. Candidates must have relevant work experience, valid educational and experience documents, basic English communication skills, and a valid passport with at least two years of validity. GCC experience is mandatory for selected positions. The employer provides legal recruitment, visa assistance, accommodation, medical insurance, and a secure working environment. Selection is based on CV and working video. Shortlisted candidates must submit their original passport immediately for further processing. Apply now with FTS Flytap Services Pvt. Ltd.
